sourceReview.reason: No distinct 2026-11-09 Ondo announcement substantiating this headline was found. Primary-source materials document earlier expansions: tokenized equities and ETFs on 360X announced 2026-04-15 and Ondo Intelligent Portfolios announced in September 2026. The Google News discovery link does not establish a new November 9 event or full-text evidence. Hold until a dated primary release or two independent full-text reports confirm a new development.
